meta.method: Read directly from the IFC STEP text by a dependency-free STEP parser (scripts/ref/step.mjs) and the REQ-002 rules in scripts/ref/ifc-model.mjs; no web-ifc, no fragments, no product code. Elements = rooted IfcProduct instances except spatial structure, relations, type objects and property definitions. Kategorie = IFC class as spelled in the schema (IfcWallStandardCase). Typ = Name of the type object via IfcRelDefinesByType. Geschoss = Name of the nearest IfcBuildingStorey up the containment/aggregation tree. Material = sorted distinct IfcMaterial names of the element's IfcRelAssociatesMaterial (IfcMaterial, list, layer set (usage), constituent set, profile set (usage)), else of its type. Properties keyed '<Pset/Qto name>.<Property>', occurrence over type. Length/area/volume values converted to m/m²/m³ with the project IfcUnitAssignment (SI prefix or IfcConversionBasedUnit factor); other numeric values unconverted. Values rounded to 12 significant digits; compare numbers with a tolerance of 1e-9 relative.

REQ-006-grouping-fzk.note: Every STEP element by Kategorie (sorted) then Geschoss ('(leer)' = no storey): count, sum of BaseQuantities.NetVolume (Neumaier sum of the unrounded values, then rounded to 12 significant digits; null = no element of the group has a volume) and the common value of the text columns Geschoss / Name / Typ (null = differs or empty). Group rows of the product exist only for the classes it lists as rows; the total row is the sum over those classes.

REQ-006-grouping-duplex.note: Material = sorted distinct IfcMaterial names (REQ-002). Each material group lists its elements by Kategorie with count and sum of PSet_Revit_Dimensions.Volume (m³; Neumaier sum, rounded to 12 significant digits; null = none has a volume). An element with n materials is in n groups; totalByKategorie counts and sums each element once. Tests leave out the classes the extractor does not list as rows.

REQ-007-selection.note: Group selection (REQ-007): a group row selects every element of the group inside the filter; 3D highlights those with geometry. Kategorie = IFC class, Geschoss = nearest IfcBuildingStorey name (REQ-002 rules).

REQ-009-config.note: Property keys '<Pset>.<Property>' (occurrence over type) of elements of row classes (IfcAnnotation, IfcOpeningElement, IfcVirtualElement, IfcDistributionPort, IfcSpace left out). absentProperty and absentKategorie exist in the Duplex fixture and not in AC20-FZK-Haus.

REQ-008-export.note: Single view: every IfcWallStandardCase of both files (STEP id order per file). Zahl.csv is the IfcReal literal of the STEP text with a decimal comma (expected CSV cell); Text is the decoded IfcText (STEP \X2\ escapes). Material = sorted distinct names, joined with ', ' in the export. Grouped: the walls of AC20-FZK-Haus (element rows under the expanded IfcWallStandardCase group) with NetVolume rounded to 12 significant digits; group rows and the total row from REQ-006-grouping-fzk.

REQ-012-rules.note: DEC-19 matching re-implemented here on the STEP text (toLocaleString de-DE, at most 3 decimals; IFC booleans Ja/Nein; lower-case comparison; multi-valued Material per value). AC6 checks every attribute, Typ, Geschoss, Material and every pset/qto value of every row for the GlobalId (Modell and Geometrie are not GlobalIds).

REQ-013-tools.note: DEC-18 shown sets on the STEP text: AC5 = all FZK rows minus the two toolWalls (hidden) or exactly them (isolated), grouped by Kategorie with Neumaier sums of BaseQuantities.NetVolume (null = no value). REQ-004-AC5 = Kategorie counts of the rows whose Kategorie contains 'wall' (lower case), then without afterHiding.GlobalId. REQ-012-AC14 = Duplex rows whose occurrence/type value of the property contains the value (lower case); fzkHasProperty false = the rule's property is gone once the Duplex model is removed.

REQ-006-AC1.note: Single Kategorie filter set with four checked values (OR). No single value or Kategorie x Geschoss/Material/Typ combination of the fetched fixtures gives exactly 2,000. The four counts equal the counts in the spike's fragments table (spike-extraction-check/out/mep.frag.table.json), so they do not depend on geometry. Y (all rows) depends on the extractor's class set and the IfcSpace option and is read from window.__calc at test time.
